description: Answers tenants’ questions about repairs, damp and mould and disrepair in rented homes in England and Wales, from RemedyBridge’s published guides: what a landlord must repair and how quickly, Awaab’s Law, section 11 of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 and fitness for human habitation, reporting repairs, landlord complaints and the Housing Ombudsman, free helplines and who each one is for, Environmental Health and HHSRS, withholding rent, eviction after a complaint, the pre-action protocol and evidence. It searches the quick answer and the questions and answers of every guide, and a glossary of 54 housing terms, and returns each answer with the link to its page. Use it for "what is", "who is responsible", "how long" and "what can I do" questions. It does not assess anyone’s situation.

query.description: The question or term in plain words, e.g. "how long does my landlord have to fix a leak" or "section 11".
